description.narrative: The Project will remove a transport constraint to sustainable economic growth. Providing economic railway transporation in the unserved, less-developed, and poor areas will help create conditions necessary for developing local resources and generating employment and income-enhancing opportunities to raise living standards in the project area. The project comprises the following components: (i) construction of 459 km double-track electrified standard gauge Class I passenger dedicated railway between Zhengzhou and Xi'an, (ii) construction of 9 new railway stations complete with facilities, (iii) safety initiatives, including provision of modern technology and equipment for enhancing safety, (iv) e-governance and operating disptach information system, (v) provision of training on the use and maintenance of modern equipment, (vi) land acqusition and resettlement, (vii) environmental protection and mitigation of adverse environmental effects, (viii) consulting services for construction supervision, monitoring and evaluation, and marketing and business development, and (ix) strengthening of institutional capabilities. The key inputs needed for project implementation include civil works, equipment, consultants, and staff of MOR and the Project Company.

description.narrative: An efficient, safe, reliable, and affordable railway transport system is developed in the region
Travel time reduced from Beijing to Xian by 7 hours from 2005 to 2013 Progress/Status: Will be assessed during project completion mission. Data Source: Project review missions reports Actual value:
Travel time reduced from Zhengzhou to Xian by 5 hours from 2005 to 2013 Progress/Status: Will be assessed during project completion mission. Data Source: PCR Actual value:
Cost of travel reduced from 28 fen/km in 2005 to 15 fen/km in 2013 Progress/Status: Will be assessed during project completion mission. Actual value:
Number of tourists visiting the project area increased from 370,000 in 2005 to 500,000 in 2013 Progress/Status: Will be assessed during project completion mission. Actual value:

Passenger traffic volume increased from 53 pairs of passenger trains in 2005 to 75 pairs in 2013 Progress/Status: Increased by nine pairs passenger trains in 2010. Data Source: MOR and local government statistics Actual value:

Freight traffic volume increased from 89 million tons in 2005 to 100 million tons in 2013 Progress/Status: The progress will be assessed during project completion mission. Data Source: Progress reports Actual value:
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: 1. Railway infrastructure and associated facilities improved along the Zhengzhou-Xian railway corridor Indicator: 459 km of railway line and 9 stations constructed; equipment procured and installed for train operations by June 2012 Progress/Status: Railway line and stations completed. Data Source: Project administration manual (PAM) PCR Project progress reports Actual value:

Output: 2. Employment opportunities generated for the poor and vulnerable groups to raise incomes and living standards, and reduce poverty Indicator: 353,000 person-months of construction-related employment are generated, of which the poor, including women, capture 50% of unskilled labor by Dec 2012 Progress/Status: This was complied with as confirmed in the external monitoring reports. Data Source: Monitoring reports from the Project Company and external monitoring agency Actual value:

Output: 3. Corporate governance promoted Indicator: A debt-to-equity ratio of not more than 65:35, an operating ratio of not more than 70%, a debt-service coverage ratio of not less than 1.2, and a financial rate of return of 7% Progress/Status: This will be assessed at Project Completion. Data Source: Financial statements of the Project Company, midterm review, and PCR Baseline year: 2003 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2003 Baseline value: N Target year: 2012 Target value: Y

Output: 4. Institutional capacity of the Project Company strengthened Indicator: An effective marketing program is developed to attract passenger and tourists along the ZXR by June 2012 Progress/Status: The EA confirmed that trainings are ongoing and a marketing program was already developed and financed by the EA. Data Source: PAMs, Project progress reports, and consultants' reports Baseline year: 2003 Baseline value: N Baseline year: 2003 Baseline value: N Target year: 2012 Target value: Y
